about: Get a To Whom It May Concern certificate that says whether you receive social support from the ministry.
note: Requirements read from the official MOCD service page on the checked date. MOCD fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. The ministry is named MOCD in this file; its site is moce.gov.ae. Certificate of social support status. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Open to all citizens and residents of the UAE
A personal profile must exist on the online platform
timing: About 1 minute to apply, issued instantly
channels: MOCD website, sign in with UAE PASS
